title: Micro-sized CVD-derived Si–C anodes: challenges, strategies, and prospects for next-generation high-energy lithium-ion batteries
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,4037-4052
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE01568E, Perspective
Zhexi Xiao, Haojun Wu, Lijiao Quan, Fanghong Zeng, Ruoyu Guo, Zekai Ma, Xiaoyu Chen, Jiaqi Zhan, Kang Xu, Lidan Xing, Weishan Li
